ticker_news.title: Strifor lanza un programa de recompensas para reconocer a sus mejores socios IB
ticker_news.description: Strifor, a regulated broker, introduces a new rewards program for Introducing Broker (IB) partners, offering exclusive Apple product prizes based on client referral performance and trading volume.
ticker_news.author: Strifor

ticker_news.title: Strifor lança programa de recompensas para reconhecer os principais desempenhos de Ibs
ticker_news.description: Strifor introduces a premium rewards program for Introducing Brokers (IB), offering Apple products like MacBook Air, iPhone Pro, and AirPods Max to top-performing partners based on client referral and trading volume.
ticker_news.author: Strifor

ticker_news.title: Strifor Launches Rewards Program Recognizing Top IB Performers
ticker_news.description: Strifor introduces a premium prize initiative for Introducing Broker partners, offering Apple products as rewards for top-performing partners based on client trading volume and referral performance.
ticker_news.author: Strifor Representative

ticker_news.title: These 20 Stocks Now Make Up Half Of The S&P 500—Here's Why That's Risky
ticker_news.description: The top 20 stocks in the S&P 500 now represent 50.8% of the index's market value, up from 28% in 2015, driven by AI enthusiasm. Despite high market concentration, these companies only generate 9.1% of total earnings, raising concerns about potential market volatility.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari
